note: Ask Myte eval set (ADR-0047). world = the fake bff's default tool results; each case may override them in fixture. script = the scripted model's rounds for the offline plumbing check ([[needle]] cites the source line containing needle). expect = what a passing answer does; criteria are for human/live review. v2 (ADR-0049) adds peer_myte, memory, actions_v2, attachments and person_scope cases; a case may carry memories, attachments, mode and peer like the stream request, and expect.answer_must_not_contain.
